name: Planet Colonist Transfer Atomicity and Landing Acceptance

tests.name: Place player and active ship in sector but not landed

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=1,lastplanet=977703 WHERE name='colonist_transfer_owner'
UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1,onplanet=FALSE,holds=20,colonists=5 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='colonist_transfer_owner')
INSERT INTO ship_cargo(ship_id,commodity_code,quantity) SELECT ship_id,'COL',5 FROM players WHERE name='colonist_transfer_owner' ON CONFLICT(ship_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=5

tests.name: Remote pickup preserves population and cargo

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.population=10 AND p.colonists_unassigned=10 AND s.colonists=5 AND c.quantity=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets p JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=@{colonist_transfer_owner_player_id} JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=pl.ship_id JOIN ship_cargo c ON c.ship_id=s.ship_id AND c.commodity_code='COL' WHERE p.planet_id=977703
UPDATE ships SET onplanet=TRUE WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='colonist_transfer_owner')

tests.name: Pickup transfers population into ship atomically
Pickup conserves total population and cargo

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.population=7 AND p.colonists_unassigned=7 AND s.colonists=8 AND c.quantity=8 AND p.population+c.quantity=15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets p JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=@{colonist_transfer_owner_player_id} JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=pl.ship_id JOIN ship_cargo c ON c.ship_id=s.ship_id AND c.commodity_code='COL' WHERE p.planet_id=977703

tests.name: Dropoff transfers population into planet atomically

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.population=9 AND p.colonists_unassigned=9 AND s.colonists=6 AND c.quantity=6 AND p.population+c.quantity=15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets p JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=@{colonist_transfer_owner_player_id} JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=pl.ship_id JOIN ship_cargo c ON c.ship_id=s.ship_id AND c.commodity_code='COL' WHERE p.planet_id=977703

tests.name: Dropoff into slave population fails closed
Failed mixed-population transfer rolls back both sides

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.population=9 AND p.population_type='SLAVE' AND p.colonists_unassigned=9 AND s.colonists=6 AND c.quantity=6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets p JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=@{colonist_transfer_owner_player_id} JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=pl.ship_id JOIN ship_cargo c ON c.ship_id=s.ship_id AND c.commodity_code='COL' WHERE p.planet_id=977703
